raw_printing.name: Reckless Innovator
raw_printing.rules_html:
[Accelerate] (You may pay :rb_energy_1::rb_rune_chaos: as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
When I become exhausted, choose one —

  • Play a Gold gear token exhausted. (It has "[Reaction][>] Kill this, :rb_exhaust:: [Add] :rb_rune_rainbow:.")
  • Pay :rb_rune_chaos: to draw 1.
